title: Changing Meal Plan: Window, Cooldown, Charge and Effective Basis
content:
An employee moving between the six plans of the Employee Meal Account line is governed by four figures, printed here against every plan.

| Meal plan | Annual window for a change outside a life event | Cooldown after a change | Administration charge | A change takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | 30 calendar days | 3 months | $0.00 | at once |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | 30 calendar days | 3 months | $0.00 | at once |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | 30 calendar days | 6 months | $0.00 | at the start of the next payroll period |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | 14 calendar days | 6 months | $0.00 | on the first day of the next month |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | 14 calendar days | 12 months | $0.00 | on the first day of the next month |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | 60 calendar days | 12 months | $35.00 | at the start of the next payroll period |

## The four figures

The change window is the calendar days each year during which the employee may change plan outside a life event. The cooldown is the months that must pass after a plan change before another is accepted. The administration charge is what a plan change costs. The effective basis is when a plan change takes effect — at once, at the start of the next payroll period, or on the first day of the next month.

## Points of judgement

Windows run 30 calendar days on the three lowest plans, 14 on the Subsidized Daily Allowance Account and the Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account, and 60 on the Executive Dining Charge Account. Cooldowns run 3 months, 3 months, 6 months, 6 months, 12 months and 12 months in plan order, so an employee whose last change was 5 months ago satisfies a 3 month cooldown and not a 6 month one. Only the Executive Dining Charge Account carries an administration charge, at $35.00; every other plan prints $0.00. The effective basis is at once on the three lowest plans, the start of the next payroll period on the Payroll Deduction Meal Account and on the Executive Dining Charge Account, and the first day of the next month on the Subsidized Daily Allowance Account and the Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account.
